data.narrative:
Alpha School is a Series A AI & Software company founded by MacKenzie Price and Brian Holtz. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private peers and 1 public company (Palantir, ticker PLTR), with particular focus on five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies: Scale AI, Reflection AI, Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, and Field AI.

The peer-median method, the applicable triangulation approach given data availability, anchors on the median valuation of $5.6B across these five comparables. The peer set ranges from $2.0B (Field AI, Series B) to $29.0B (Scale AI, Series B), with Physical Intelligence at the median at $5.6B. This method reflects stage and sector alignment; however, the wide dispersion—from $2.0B to $29.0B—signals material variance in how the market values AI & Software companies at this stage, likely driven by differences in traction, team composition, and technical differentiation.

The triangulated valuation range is $4.8B to $6.4B, centered at the peer median of $5.6B. This narrow output range reflects reliance on a single method. Key uncertainties include Alpha School's current revenue, growth rate, and burn profile relative to the peer set, none of which are provided. The wide peer dispersion and absence of revenue or unit-economics data also suggest meaningful optionality within and above this range depending on demonstrated commercial traction.
